title: 巴西葡萄牙语金融新闻多分类大规模数据集
summary: 该研究构建了约16万篇巴西葡萄牙语金融新闻的大规模语料库，并基于语义相似度进行弱监督多分类基准测试。实验表明任务对标签质量和类别分布高度敏感，人工标注子集上KNN表现最佳（准确率47.3%，F1值31.9%），而LLM标注子集F1值降至约20%，凸显高质量人工标注的必要性。
summary_en: This work presents a large-scale corpus of ~160,000 Brazilian Portuguese financial news articles and establishes weakly supervised multi-class classification baselines based on semantic similarity. Experiments show the task is highly sensitive to label quality and class distribution: KNN achieved the best performance on the manually labeled subset (47.3% accuracy, 31.9% F1), while LLM-annotated subsets saw F1 drop to ~20%, highlighting the critical need for high-quality manual annotations.
